title: こどもの日のイラスト
subject_en: Children's Day icons, each a separate object, flat Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: 鯉のぼり、兜、柏餅、菖蒲など、こどもの日(端午の節句)のモチーフ12点。5月のおたよりや掲示に。
items: a pole with three carp streamers and a pinwheel
a kashiwa mochi wrapped in a leaf
chimaki rice dumplings tied with grass
a cute boy doll with a red apron and an axe (original design)
a carp jumping out of the water
